caption.title: Rich document note editor
caption.state: Eligible full rich editor, isolated owner build flag1, saved note, document mode active, outline docked

functionalInvariants: Every input constraint, action guard and important-state contract below is required. This plan is not a claim that incompatible states coexist or that source-only states ran.
Owner navigation may use the existing ToDoo two-level hierarchy; public guest and standalone reading may not contain private chrome.

FIELD WS-024 正文 [rich-document; required]: Lossless Markdown-backed rich editor. Rich eligibility: feature flag VITE_DOCUMENT_EDITOR_ENABLED=1, full server mode, <=262144 UTF-8 bytes, <=5000 units, depth<=32. Server ordinary cutoff1MiB/long-line32768 routes larger files to large mode. Unsupported syntax is preserved, not discarded.
STATE WS-024: Shared status warns saved changes publish
STATE WS-024: Read-only during draft recovery/transfer
STATE WS-024: Local draft saved timestamp

POLICY Authenticated owner browser session; /api owner hook returns 401 if absent and 503 during maintenance. Mutations require configured Origin and CSRF token (apps/server/app.ts:141). No administrator/member role split is implemented for these owner surfaces.

POLICY Formatting is disabled without a full-mode note, in reading mode, before draft identity is ready, while note opens/transfers or drafts load/write, or while a recovery draft is offered (Workspace.vue:627).

POLICY Owner workspace rich editing tabs exist only when VITE_DOCUMENT_EDITOR_ENABLED=1. Actual deployed build flag is unverified. Eligibility additionally caps rich Markdown at262144 UTF-8 bytes,5000 units, depth32; fallback uses existing source editor.
WS-024: Owner workspace VITE_DOCUMENT_EDITOR_ENABLED gate is not the public guest host configuration; PB-026/PB-027 own guest document/source modes.

UI structure rather than backend state count determines bitmap jobs. StateCoverage names exact component/bindings/guards and compact matrix rows; shared-pattern is not a claim that incompatible alternatives were visually proven together.
